complaint_resolution_evidence: Bundle index-bd700f881e7c7ed0e23d8720d550d95a.js contains: (1) `getDefaultModelContextWindow = function(n){return 'codex'===n ? 2e5 : 1e6}` (codex→200k, all else (claude/gemini/unknown)→1M), and (2) call site `'default'!==e.modelMode.key ? getModelContextWindow(B) : getDefaultModelContextWindow(I)` with presence-check guard `e.usageData ?`.
